column4: Profile swap is documented and done before. A new profile is CREATED IDENTICAL to the default profile - every creation flag, not just memory/cpu: --gpus all, --mount-string /usr/lib/wsl:/usr/lib/wsl, --extra-config=kubelet.cgroup-driver=systemd, --disk-size, --base-image, and the same addon set (read ~/.minikube/profiles/minikube/config.json and diff the two configs after start - it must come back empty). .wslconfig is never a cap; existing profiles are resized with docker update + config.json.
The operator install order and image list are already scripted; the CSA/Flink helm block is commented out in the installer and must be enabled for Flink work.

cso-operator-app is live prod: read its own CLAUDE.md in that repo first; read the RUNNING pod's MODULES before any deploy (a bare deploy.sh silently drops RAG/Streamers); every redeploy needs a live NiFi flow-state check AND a fresh ask.
flink-agents (#231) built and ran on cso-prod-1: image 0.3.1, FlinkDeployment STABLE, destroy path proven. Start from those files.

Parameter Context inheritance (#203) is validated: base cluster-creds → child contexts; enc{} in flow.json never proves a literal — check referencingComponents; never GET-then-PUT a processor with sensitive properties.

Adding/updating a PG without touching the root flow is skill rule 10 + flow-registry.md (upload, upsert = stop→drain→delete→reimport, param pre-create from Secrets). Re-export the checked-in flow after any live edit.

EFM agent enrollment: only the Deploy Agent CLI screen or POST /efm/api/agent-deployer/generateCommand (omit agentIdentifier). Never hand-build the command, never reuse an identifier. Flow Designer API is reverse-engineered in the same reference.

Custom NiFi processors: PVC not minikube mount, NiFi must be 2.x, rebuild→redeploy discipline, mixed-template EL trap — all written up. Prefer a FlowFile chain of native processors over one monolithic Python processor.
Kafka on the CSO cluster: the 3-broker yaml is in files/cso-prod-1; topic delete/retention-flush via the CLI does not work here — use the Surveyor UI.
Prometheus/Grafana on this cluster and the EFM/NiFi metrics relay are built and documented; EFM lastSeen is not liveness — the heartbeat counter is.
Sparkplug B / MQTT: Mosquitto runs in the mqtt namespace behind a zellij pane AND a Windows Firewall rule (both needed for LAN devices); MicroFi flows are exported in files/.

AMOLED board work is closed; those two docs are authoritative (backends :8091-:8094, fonts round DOWN off-ladder, shell is littlefs data). Build the simulator before the first flash; flashing COM8 needs no ask.
NvidiaNano (Jetson Orin Nano) setup, MiNiFi ops and inference are documented; it is reached by SSH proxy from WindowsDesktop and has its own device label.
GetIceberg (#154) and QueryIceberg (#156) NARs are built and validated on WindowsDesktop; pushdown proven; catalog.* prefix and cast-unwrap gotchas are in the plan docs.

.wslconfig is a setting Steven owns, not a hardware cap: never downsize a cluster or drop stack components to fit it. New profile sizing = the default profile's config.json (24000 MB / 12 CPUs as of 2026-08-25).
